description: Add a real, live-captured sample request/response to the README's 'Running the API locally' section: replace the existing Chicago curl example's query with 'reliable family SUV under $30k, low mileage, near Detroit', and show the actual JSON response returned by a live local run of that query.

userStories.title: Capture a real sample response for the Detroit query
userStories.description: As a developer maintaining the README, I want a genuine JSON response captured from a live run of the target query, so the documented example reflects real system behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Local API server started successfully via `uv run car-search`
`curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/search -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query": "reliable family SUV under $30k, low mileage, near Detroit"}'` executed against the running server
Raw JSON response captured and pretty-printed (e.g. via `python3 -m json.tool`)
Captured response contains actual matching listings in `results` (not an empty `clarifying_question` fallback), confirming the query is specific enough to search meaningfully
Captured response saved to a scratch file for use in US-002 (not committed to the repo)
userStories.notes: Started `uv run car-search` locally, POSTed the Detroit query, captured pretty-printed JSON (5 non-empty results, no clarifying_question) to scratchpad/detroit-response.json for use in US-002.

userStories.title: Update README with the Detroit request + captured sample response
userStories.description: As a new reader of the README, I want to see a full example request and its response together, so I understand what the API returns without running it myself.
acceptanceCriteria: In the 'Running the API locally' section, the existing Chicago curl example's query text is replaced with 'reliable family SUV under $30k, low mileage, near Detroit'
The exact JSON response captured in US-001 is added directly below the curl command, inside a fenced ```json code block
The response block is shown in full -- every top-level field (filters, results, explanation, relaxed_fields, clarifying_question) and every result listing, with no truncation
No other README sections (Setup, tests/typecheck/lint, golden-set eval, Architecture) are changed
README renders as valid Markdown: fenced code blocks are properly opened and closed
userStories.notes: Replaced Chicago query with Detroit in the curl example and added the full US-001 response as a fenced json block directly beneath it. Fence markers balanced (14, even) and `uv run mypy` passes. No other README section touched (git diff confirms scope).
